newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Cash markets firm but evening up seen ahead of cattle-on-feed report.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Mixed ahead of cattle report. Index lower and mixed corn futures calls.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.150 cent. October at large disount to cash and cash seen steady to higher.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to 0.400 cent. Cash strong and deliverable stocks remains in strong hands.
